episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The final battle at the foot of Hakusan. AI Gui, who fights Yu-yu, aims not only for a complete victory but also for the last piece of data to realize the ultimate battle that developer Shingi aspired to. And now, the true power of Gui's Dragontree Deck begins to awaken.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The overwhelming strength of Dragontree. For AI Gui, Yu-yu is merely the last fighter to analyze.
